messages:
riley: Heads-up from ops: quota dashboard is showing two separate consumption spikes for the same customer (bolt-inc). Looks like attribution split across two route headers.
taylor: Which headers are present? Any sample request?
jen: We captured a request from the TS SDK that has both `x-route-policy` and `xRoutePolicy` headers set. I think a recent TS minor bumped header casing to camelCase in the client middleware.
marco: Oh no. We rolled the routing proxy change that normalized keys to kebab-case a couple weeks ago. Most services expect `x-route-policy`. If the TS client adds `xRoutePolicy` the console parser treats it as a different key -> duplicate attribution.
riley: Sample (redacted):
```
POST /v1/chat
Headers:
  Authorization: Bearer ***
  x-route-policy: tenant=bolt-inc;priority=high
  xRoutePolicy: tenant=bolt-inc;priority=high
```
oliver: This will cause two events in quota-collector since normalization only lowercases and dasherizes. We don't currently collapse camelCase variants.
taylor: Impact: billing alerts and quota overage for bolt-inc; dashboard charts double-count token usage for ~30m window. Finance pinged support.
jen: Short term: we can (A) update quota-collector to canonicalize camelCase->kebab too, (B) patch TS SDK to revert to kebab-case header, (C) add a dashboard panel that shows "header variants" to make debugging easier.
marco: (A) is low risk and immediate; (B) is good hygiene but takes SDK release cycle. We should do both.
taylor: Agree. Can we hotpatch the collector? How fast?
marco: I'll cut a small change to the collector middleware to treat `xRoutePolicy`, `XRoutePolicy`, and any camelCase variants as `x-route-policy` for the next 14 days. I'll add a unit test matrix for header variants.
jen: I'll prep a TS SDK 2.4.2 patch to stop emitting camelCase. Change: middleware will always emit headers in header-casing-mode: 'kebab' and we'll add a config flag `headerCasingFallback: 'kebab' | 'camel'` for customers who rely on older behavior. Default to kebab.
oliver: We also need to update the console's alert rules that fuel billing notifications. Right now the alert aggregates by header key. If we canonicalize server-side that's fine, but we should backfill for the 30m window to reconcile invoices.
taylor: Can we mark affected tokens as "reconciled" in billing export? Finance wants clarity.
riley: File a billing ticket and include the raw logs + reconciled numbers. JIRA-4567 created.
marco: CI note: deploy started for quota-collector-header-normalizer v1.8.0 -> canary (us-east-1) by marco at 4921056801
jen: I'll open the TS SDK PR and aim for release tomorrow morning. I'll include a short note in the changelog and a migration blurb for customers who may have pinned older client config.
taylor: UX ask: add a small "Header source split" tile in the quota dashboard so product and support can quickly see if consumption is coming from legacy, sdk, or proxy-originated headers. That'll reduce firefighting.
oliver: I'll add that tile and wire the telemetry flag `header_origin` (values: sdk|proxy|collector) in the attribution events. Also emit `header_variant` with the raw key seen.
jen: Support heads-up: I'll draft a support playbook describing symptoms (duplicate spikes), how to check client versions, and remediation steps.
marco: Canary passed in us-east-1 at 4921056812. Rolling to prod in 30m if no regressions.
riley: Thanks team. After prod deploy, let's run a reconciliation script for bolt-inc and circulate corrected numbers to finance/support.
dev-bot: reconciliation job queued -> JOB-901 at 4921056812
